newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber steady on Tokyo strength.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber steady on Tokyo strength.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were steady at midday, with the market taking its cue from an early rise in Tokyo futures, traders said.
Trading remained thin, with small parcels of SMR10 and SMR20 reported sold to China and Italy, said the traders.

"We got news that a small volume of SMR10 was traded to Beijing at 255 cents a kg for May," said an official trade source. "There was also a small consignment of SMR20 for Milan done at 250 cents (a kg) for May."
At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted June RSS1 buyer unchanged at 270.50 cents ($1.08) a kg.
June SMR 20 buyer was up one cent at 255.50.
Traders said the prices were basically a reflection of the demand for futures in the Tokyo market.
At noon, trading houses were offering the SMR CV at 328 cents a kg, SMR L at 307, SMR 5 at 266, SMR 10 at 258 and drum latex at 226 cents.
